transcript.text: A focused fool can accomplish more than
a distracted genius.
Lack of focus is a form of cowardice.
You don't believe in yourself enough to
go all in. And the world will reward you
in proportion to your courage, not your
intellect. And so in my early days, I
felt like I had to numb myself. Like
there was so much work, the amount of
work that you can only measure by
weighing it, not counting it. And if I
stopped to think about how unfinishable
the amount of work that I had was,
I wanted to quit. And so I did the only
thing I could do, I took the first thing
off the stack and I [music] would start
without thinking about how shitty or
alone I felt in that moment. And so
there's a reason that race horses wear
blinders, right? Focus only on what's in
front of you and you will get through it
and you will keep going. Because at the
end of the day, focus beats
intelligence, consistency beats
intensity, and action beats intention.
